name: Secret Some
source:
Connections between people often begin unexpectedly.

I had lived a quiet life, with no real encounters or connections with the opposite sex.
But one day, out of the blue, I found myself entangled in a relationship with four different people and my ordinary life was completely turned upside down.

Secretly, sweetly, peacefully, and joyfully, a secret romance began with each of them.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4047680/Secret_Some/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
人与人之间的联系往往是在意想不到的情况下开始的。

我一直过着平静的生活，与异性没有真正的接触或联系。
但有一天，出乎意料的是，我发现自己卷入了与四个不同人的关系中，我平凡的生活完全被颠覆了。

秘密地、甜蜜地、平静地、快乐地，他们各自开始了一段秘密的恋情。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4047680/Secret_Some/]Steam[/url]]
